postconditions.description: The output sequence must have exactly N elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= N for a in output)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output sequence must be a positive integer between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: output != -1 or (output == -1 and not any(graph_matches(output, graph) for graph in possible_graphs))
postconditions.description: If the output is -1, it must be because no sequence can match the graph. Otherwise, the output must be a valid sequence that matches the graph.

invariants.expression: all(0 <= x < N for x in graph_edges[0])
invariants.description: The starting node for all edges in the graph is always V0.

invariants.expression: all(0 <= y < N for _, y, _ in graph_edges[1:])
invariants.description: The ending node for all edges in the graph is always one of the nodes V1 through VN.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= b <= N for _, b, _ in graph_edges[2:])
invariants.description: The label on all edges in the graph is a positive integer between 1 and N.

invariants.expression: all(graph_edges[x][0] == 0 for x in range(1, len(graph_edges)))
invariants.description: All edges in the graph start from node V0.

invariants.expression: all(graph_edges[x][2] == graph_edges[x+1][2] for x in range(len(graph_edges) - 1))
invariants.description: There are no multiple edges with the same label between the same pair of nodes.
